name: VolSplat
aliases: Rethinking Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Voxel-Aligned Prediction
definition: A feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting method that regresses Gaussians from 3D features using a voxel-aligned prediction strategy to solve multi-view alignment and adaptive density control.
summary: VolSplat is a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting method that uses voxel-aligned prediction to solve multi-view alignment and enable adaptive density control.
